prompt: What does "least-privilege execution context" mean per invocation?
explanation: Least-privilege per invocation: the agent gets exactly what the current task needs. This limits blast radius — if the agent misbehaves or is compromised, damage is bounded.

options.text: The agent gets the maximum permissions it might ever need, pre-provisioned
Each agent invocation receives only the minimum permissions for that specific task — no broader access even if broader access exists
All agents share a single global permission set
Permissions are set at deployment and never change
